22. impl FrameNumber {
23.     // Models `FrameNumber::MAX = MAX_ADDRESS / FRAME_SIZE - 1`: the largest representable frame
24.     // index. A module-wide constant, not per-value state. It is `uninterp` (its concrete value
25.     // bottoms out at the build-time page-size constants, an external boundary) and is tied to the
26.     // exec constant `FrameNumber::MAX` by the `assume_specification` below. Realizes the kernel's
27.     // uninterpreted `spec_max_frame_number()` (see `hal/mem/types/address/phys.spec.rs`). The `nat`
28.     // result makes the bound non-negative for callers (e.g. constructing `FrameNumber::NULL`).
29.     pub uninterp spec fn spec_max() -> nat;
30. 
31.     // Every constructible `FrameNumber` is bounded by `MAX`. Enforced as a type invariant so the
32.     // bound holds unconditionally for any value callers hold (PTE/PDE treat it as an always-valid
33.     // token), which is exactly what lets `into_raw_value() << FRAME_SHIFT` not overflow `usize`.
34.     #[verifier::type_invariant]
35.     pub open spec fn inv(&self) -> bool {
36.         0 <= self@ <= Self::spec_max()

20. ///
21. /// # Description
22. ///
23. /// A type that represents a frame number.
24. /// A frame number is in the range from `0` to [`Self::MAX`] (inclusive).
25. ///
26. #[verus_verify]
27. #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
28. pub struct FrameNumber(usize);
29. 
30. //==================================================================================================
31. // Implementations
32. //==================================================================================================

36. // `assume_specification[FrameNumber::MAX]` in `number.spec.rs`.
37. impl FrameNumber {
38.     /// The maximum frame number.
39.     pub const MAX: usize = mem::MAX_ADDRESS / mem::FRAME_SIZE - 1;
40. }

43. impl FrameNumber {
44.     #[verus_spec(ensures Self::NULL@ == 0)]
45.     pub const NULL: Self = Self(0);
46.

48.     /// # Description
49.     ///
50.     /// Constructs a [`FrameNumber`].
51.     ///
52.     /// # Parameters
53.     ///
54.     /// - `value`: The value of the frame number.
55.     ///
56.     /// # Returns

59.     /// - `None`: If the value is greater than [`Self::MAX`].
60.     ///

62.         ensures
63.             value as int <= Self::spec_max() ==> (result is Some
64.                 && (result->Some_0)@ == value as int),
65.             value as int > Self::spec_max() ==> result is None,
66.     )]

88.     )]
